column3: “obtain children through her” renders “be built up through her,” a play on “son” (ben) and “build” (banah).
“in your power” renders “in your hand,” and “treated her harshly” renders “afflicted her.”
NASB leaves “the angel of the LORD” lowercase (also in verses 9–11).
“submit yourself to her authority” renders “humble yourself under her hands.”
“to the east of” renders “over against,” which can also mean “in defiance of.”
the second half of the verse is obscure in the Hebrew (literally “Have I also here seen after the One who sees me?”).
“Beer-lahai-roi” means “well of the Living One who sees me.”
